scope: novelty / anti-rescue audit of the six D1 V8 proposals: measured rank-correlation evidence against the forbidden space. RANKS ONLY - no PnL, no backtest, no arm scoring anywhere in this audit.

inputs.forbidden_inventory: research/control/stocks_free_v8_run/forbidden_family_inventory.json (V7 carry-forward, 8 families + shadow region + blocked channels)
inputs.v4_anchor_definitions: research/control/stocks_free_v4_run/proposals/{a4_h1,a5_h1}.json + stocks_free_v4_run/d2_a7_novelty_audit.json (REF-MOM/REF-VOL) + stocks_free_v4_run/selection_freeze.json (63-session decision clock for the stale-rank control)

implementation_notes.decision_dates: the 30 frozen quarterly census dates 2018-04-04..2025-05-23; all 30 are exact union sessions of the staged price files - NO snapping to nearest session was needed
implementation_notes.eligibility_per_P3_floor: filer among the 409 staged price files; ADV63 = median(RAW close*RAW volume) over 63 sessions ending at the last readable session, ADV63 >= 2,000,000 USD; RAW close >= 1.00 USD at the last readable session; per-date eligible population 389..408 (median 404), consistent with the proposals' cited p2 populations (390/405/408 at start/mid/end)
implementation_notes.availability_convention: P3 v8_additions: a decision at session d reads bars through session d-1; every trailing window (ADV63, DVOL_share, CLV mean, momentum, semivariance, vol, participation shock) ends at the last readable session; RAW price >= 1.00 likewise evaluated there
implementation_notes.stale_serving_rule: a name must have traded within 14 calendar days before the decision date, else it is excluded at that decision (fail-closed; long-gapped/delisted series never ranked)
implementation_notes.fundamentals_vintage_semantics: selected vintage per (entity, field, evaluation point) = max avail among rows with avail_date < evaluation point (gate = 00:00 UTC of the session; avail stamp = end of filed UTC day, so avail_date < decision date) and age = (evaluation point - avail_date).days <= bound; bounds exactly as cited clocks; the year-earlier evaluation point = decision date minus one calendar year; a4_h1 denominator Assets evaluated at the year-earlier point with age<=400 relative to that point; a name missing any leg is unpopulated that decision

proposal_anchor_definitions.a4_h1: accrual flow (AR+INV-AP YoY deltas)/Assets(y-1y, age<=400), within-sector percentile rank of the frozen sector tag (as the proposal defines the tradable rank)
proposal_anchor_definitions.a4_h2: AccumDepPP&E / PP&Egross (both age<=400), within-sector percentile rank
proposal_anchor_definitions.a5_h1: 12m log change of dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding, age<=400 at both evaluation points
proposal_anchor_definitions.a5_h2: 12m log change of us-gaap:Assets, age<=120 at both evaluation points
proposal_anchor_definitions.a6_h1: DVOL_share = sum(RAW dv | RAW ret<0)/sum(RAW dv) over 63 sessions; RAW close-to-close returns; H>L not applicable (close-based)
proposal_anchor_definitions.a6_h2: mean CLV over 63 sessions on days with H>L (one-print days excluded from that day's mean)

forbidden_anchor_definitions.mom12_1: 12-1 cross-sectional momentum: adj_close(t-21)/adj_close(t-252) - 1 (V4 A7-N REF-MOM; V2 A4_XSEC_ETF_RELATIVE_MOMENTUM family axis), windows end at last readable session
forbidden_anchor_definitions.semi126: semivariance-SHAPE: sum(r^2 | r<0)/sum(r^2) over trailing 126 sessions (SFV4-A4-H1-A anchor definition), adjusted returns
forbidden_anchor_definitions.vol252: realized vol LEVEL: RMS daily adjusted return over trailing 252 sessions (V4 SFV4-A4-H1-C level axis, V4 A7-N REF-VOL definition)
forbidden_anchor_definitions.shock21_252: participation shift: mean(dv, last 21)/mean(dv, prior 231 of 252) RAW dollar volume (SFV4-A5-H1-A anchor definition)
forbidden_anchor_definitions.shock21_252_stale63: stale-rank variant: the same shock with windows shifted back 63 sessions (SFV4-A5-H1-C 'one-quarter-stale participation ranks'; V4 decision clock was 63 sessions)

implementation_notes.series_choice: adjusted_close for return-based forbidden anchors (split-consistent); RAW for dollar-volume, a6 anchors, ADV63 and price floor, per proposal definitions
implementation_notes.spearman: rank(average ties) + Pearson; per-date cross-section requires n>=30 paired observations else NOT_MEASURED for that date; NO date fell below the floor - 30/30 dates measured for every (proposal, forbidden) pair
implementation_notes.gate_statistic: pooled mean of the 30 per-date Spearman rhos (primary, V6-precedent form); breach = |pooled mean| > 0.20 vs ANY forbidden anchor => INELIGIBLE (novelty veto). Per-date ranges, per-date breach counts and observation-pooled rho are reported as fail-closed disclosure, not as a second gate
implementation_notes.sector_tags: frozen sector tag from _panel_entities.json; 0 mismatches vs the panel rows' modal tag
implementation_notes.covered_name_counts: eligible rows 12,003 over 30 dates; populated (proposal-anchor, forbidden-anchor) pairs per cell 5,128..12,003 (fundamentals cells limited by joint vintage coverage, all >= 30 per date)
declared_approximations: forbidden anchors were defined by V4 on sector ETFs; here they are applied at single-name level on the same panel and dates, as instructed
the stale-rank anchor uses a 63-session lag, matching the V4 63-session decision clock (one decision period stale)
a4_h1/a4_h2 measured on their as-defined within-sector percentile vectors; raw-vector sensitivity measured and materially identical (see NOTE N2)

momentum/vol anchors use the adjusted series; the a6 proposals' own RAW-close convention was kept for their anchors; a split inside a 63-day RAW window can flip at most the sign label of the split-day return (immaterial at cross-sectional rank scale)

gate.rule: |pooled mean Spearman rho| > 0.20 vs any forbidden anchor => INELIGIBLE (novelty veto); |rho| > 0.60 pairwise between proposals flagged

a4_h1.gate: |pooled mean Spearman rho| <= 0.20 vs every forbidden anchor

a4_h2.gate: |pooled mean Spearman rho| <= 0.20 vs every forbidden anchor

a5_h1.gate: |pooled mean Spearman rho| <= 0.20 vs every forbidden anchor

a5_h2.gate: |pooled mean Spearman rho| <= 0.20 vs every forbidden anchor

a6_h1.gate: |pooled mean Spearman rho| <= 0.20 vs every forbidden anchor

a6_h2.gate: |pooled mean Spearman rho| <= 0.20 vs every forbidden anchor

a6_h1.note: no PIT conditioning; 154-clock rule vacuous, declared in proposal

a6_h2.note: no PIT conditioning; 154-clock rule vacuous, declared in proposal

structural_screen.screen_label_note: a5_h1/a5_h2/a6_h1/a6_h2 address SFV4-A4-H1-SEMIVARIANCE-SHAPE under the combined key 'SFV4-A4-H1-SEMIVARIANCE-SHARE_and_vol_level_shadow' (SHARE vs SHAPE label deviation; content explicitly addresses the family and the V6 measured-closed region, so recorded as cosmetic, not a coverage gap)
structural_screen.blocked_channels: no proposal consumes a blocked channel; blocked-channel names appear only inside the screens' own non-use declarations

wave_axis_discipline.a4_h1: FUNDAMENTALS-QUALITY lane; anchor built solely from 5 SEC panel fields (verified by measurement reimplementation)
wave_axis_discipline.a4_h2: FUNDAMENTALS-QUALITY lane; anchor built solely from 4 SEC panel fields + Assets denominator
wave_axis_discipline.a5_h1: FUNDAMENTALS-INVESTMENT/ISSUANCE lane; anchor solely dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding vintages
wave_axis_discipline.a5_h2: FUNDAMENTALS-INVESTMENT/ISSUANCE lane; anchor solely us-gaap:Assets vintages
wave_axis_discipline.a6_h1: non-fundamentals price/volume lane; anchor built solely from EODHD RAW close*volume and RAW return signs; no SEC field touched
wave_axis_discipline.a6_h2: non-fundamentals price/volume lane; anchor built solely from EODHD RAW H/L/C geometry; no volume, no SEC field

findings.finding: NOVELTY VETO. DVOL_share ranks couple to the V4 semivariance-SHAPE forbidden anchor at pooled rho +0.287 (25/30 dates |rho|>0.20, worst +0.49 @2022-03-11) and to the 12-1 momentum forbidden anchor at pooled rho -0.258 (22/30 dates, worst -0.52 @2020-04-03). The proposal enters the measured-closed vol-level shadow region at the Section 1.1 front door (V6 precedent: closed at rho 0.319); the binding gate is 0.20 and the proposal's own falsifiable_prediction commits to abandonment if |rho|>0.20 measured before selection. Its own preregistered diagnostic (Spearman vs 63-day cumulative-return ranks, expected |rho|<=0.5, flag >=0.6) measures mean -0.677, range [-0.778,-0.482]: the flag line fires on the panel cross-section.

NOVELTY VETO. Mean-CLV ranks couple to the 12-1 momentum forbidden anchor at pooled rho +0.291 (23/30 dates |rho|>0.20, worst +0.59 @2020-04-03) and to the V4 semivariance-SHAPE anchor at pooled rho -0.242 (19/30 dates, worst -0.46 @2021-03-12). Same shadow-region breach and same preregistered abandonment commitment as a6_h1. Additionally, vol-level coupling passes pooled (-0.146) but breaches 0.20 on 17/30 individual dates (worst -0.55 @2019-04-04): the geometry axis is regime-dependently a vol proxy, the exact V4 level-axis failure form the proposal itself names as its falsification condition.

Screen-design defect (moot given the vetoes): both A6 proposals preregister self-flag thresholds of 0.4-0.6 for forbidden-anchor coupling, 2-3x weaker than the binding A7-N gate of 0.20. A screen written to those thresholds would have passed both arms despite shadow-region entry. The a6_h1 expectation '|rho|<=0.5 vs 63d cumulative return' is breached by its own measurement on 30/30 dates.

ELIGIBLE with noted coupling windows: pooled rhos all <= 0.079, but individual 2020-2021 stress dates breach 0.20 vs 12-1 momentum (4/30 dates, worst +0.23 @2020-12-09) and vs the stale-rank variant (2/30 dates, worst +0.29 @2021-06-11); vs vol252 2/30 dates marginally over 0.20. Accrual-flow ranks lean toward recent losers / high-semivariance names in stress regimes. Gate statistic (pooled) passes with wide margin; recorded for D2 awareness.

Mutual-distinctness flag: a6_h1~a6_h2 pairwise rho mean -0.478 with per-date min -0.64, crossing the 0.60 flag line on at least one date (anti-aligned, not duplicates). The two A6 arms rank the panel in substantially opposite ways; combined deployment would partially self-cancel.

Cosmetic screen-label deviation: semivariance family addressed under key '...SEMIVARIANCE-SHARE_and_vol_level_shadow' vs inventory family_id 'SFV4-A4-H1-SEMIVARIANCE-SHAPE'. Content coverage verified; no action binding on this audit.

VERIFIED claim: 'DVOL_share is structurally incapable of expressing a fresh/stale LEVEL ratio' holds by measurement - pooled rho -0.155 vs the 21d/252d participation-shock anchor and -0.018 vs its stale-rank variant. The a6_h1 veto rests on the momentum and semivariance-SHAPE axes, not on participation-shift descent.

Fundamentals-arm sector standardization is not a decorrelation device: raw vs within-sector-percentile anchor definitions give nearly identical forbidden-anchor rhos (e.g. a4_h1 vs stale63: raw +0.080 vs standardized +0.079). No hidden coupling either way.

data_sufficiency: all cells MEASURED (no NOT_MEASURED entries): every (proposal, forbidden anchor, date) cell had >= 30 paired eligible names
